title: The Benson, Marine School Walk, Dublin 2
seoTitle: The Benson, Marine School Walk, Dublin 2

prs.tagLine: Modern living in the heart of Dublin's Docklands

description:
Discover modern living in the heart of Dublin’s vibrant Docklands at The Benson, Britain Quay, Dublin 2. These beautifully designed 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments combine elegant interiors, high-spec finishes, and stunning city views.

Apartment Highlights:
•	Spacious, light-filled interiors with floor-to-ceiling glazing
•	Graphite matt kitchens with premium Miele appliances
•	Stylish bathrooms with rainfall showers and contemporary finishes
•	Private balconies or terraces for outdoor living
•	Utility rooms with washer/dryer and ample storage
•	A-rated energy efficiency with heat recovery ventilation

Exclusive Resident Amenities:
•	Concierge service & parcel collection
•	Business centre and co-working spaces
•	Rooftop sun terrace with panoramic views
•	Secure basement parking & bicycle storage
•	Pet-friendly community

Location:
•	Situated in Dublin’s Docklands, steps from tech and financial hubs
•	Short walk to Grand Canal Dock, theatres, cafés, and restaurants
•	Excellent transport links: Luas, DART, and bus routes nearby
